criteria.text: Reached product maps open as one app with part-qualified screen names, faithful navigation and state, including selected parts that have no screen.
A small product opens without a world contract or base seed, starting from an empty world plus any part seeds; present files still keep their normal checks.
Only the world key table declares writers, and conflicting part writers or part seeds refuse before upload with the key and both parts.
After every tap, the declared follow-up operations run in order after existing follow-ups, with typed scratch state that does not erase part data.
A tap whose full worst-case draw, prompt-call and follow-up cost exceeds 40 calls is explained before upload; a cost of 40 remains allowed.
Generated map and world artifacts never overwrite authored or ignored files, preserve source diagnostics and numerical seed values, and require no Story.

cases.given: phone map has home and detail; barista map has board; server part has no map; reached parts ordered phone/server/barista
cases.required_observation: phone/home, phone/detail and barista/board; initial phone/home; server kept in parts and world; selected map dependencies and tab handlers retained

cases.given: phone has local ID account/settings plus qualified target barista/board
cases.required_observation: local account/settings becomes phone/account/settings before accepting already-qualified product targets

cases.given: phone target names barista/board but barista is not selected
cases.required_observation: invalid-product-map names missing target; no redirect, partial upload or dropped handler

cases.given: part has exact home rule and wildcard overlapping home plus another screen
cases.required_observation: preserve exact-rule actions and wildcard actions on remaining screens or explicit unsupported wildcard priority refusal; no extra bridge calls

cases.given: two mapped parts have incompatible routers; a third selected part has no map
cases.required_observation: unsupported-product-router; no silently discarded router and no router requirement for mapless part

cases.given: small product has no contracts/world.md or contracts/seed-world.json; part seed is {"orders":[]}
cases.required_observation: stat optional files, never read missing files; merged world exactly {"orders":[]}; no Story/scenario

cases.given: small product has no world, base seed or part seed
cases.required_observation: empty merged world and usable map; no phantom contract dependency

cases.given: small product has present malformed base seed or symlinked world file
cases.required_observation: normal shared seed/source refusal; not mistaken for optional absence

cases.given: world key table declares orders writer phone; later explanatory table has other columns; fenced example has Key/Writer rows
cases.required_observation: orders/phone only; descriptive tables neither parsed as declarations nor rejected for missing Key/Writer

cases.given: canonical key table declares orders for phone and server
cases.required_observation: world-writer-conflict names orders, phone and server before upload

cases.given: small product has no world file; phone and server seed files both set orders to []
cases.required_observation: world-writer-conflict names key and both parts even for equal values

cases.given: handler has existing after; product plan lists clock#tick then server#advance with complete expanded result schemas
cases.required_observation: original after first, tick then advance; later operations see prior effects; distinct non-root typed scratch slots

cases.given: selected part names include product_after and product_after_; one has no map; part state includes own __proto__ key
cases.required_observation: scratch product_after__; all part keys preserved as data; no prototype mutation or erased sibling state

cases.given: draw prompt has no calls, cost 1; handler declares max_calls:19 to a no-call leaf, cost 1 + 19 * (1 + 1) = 39; no after operations; complete worst-case tap is 1 + 39 = 40
cases.required_observation: no over-limit rejection; direct count reported separately

cases.given: draw prompt has no calls, cost 1; handler declares max_calls:18 to a no-call leaf, cost 1 + 18 * (1 + 1) = 37; one after prompt declares max_calls:1 to a no-call leaf, cost 1 + 1 * (1 + 1) = 3; complete worst-case tap is 1 + 37 + 3 = 41
cases.required_observation: pre-upload explanation names authored cost contributors and 40 ceiling; no safe-budget claim from direct count

cases.given: existing after chain plus appended plan operations total nine
cases.required_observation: pre-upload explanation of eight-after limit

cases.given: app/maps/product.json authored; contracts/product-seed_1.json occupied; suffix 2 pair absent
cases.required_observation: choose product_2.json and product-seed_2.json; no repository write

cases.given: proposed generated path exists but is Git-ignored
cases.required_observation: occupancy-only safe stat reports ignored regular candidate as occupied; choose next free paired suffix; no read, upload or overwrite of ignored file; symlink/unsafe path checks remain

cases.given: exact seed bytes {"large":9007199254740993,"decimal":0.10000000000000001,"nearOne":1.0000000000000001,"tiny":1e-400,"flag":false,"nil":null,"array":[1e-400],"__proto__":{"kept":true}}
cases.required_observation: merged seed artifact is exactly {"__proto__":{"kept":true},"array":[1e-400],"decimal":0.10000000000000001,"flag":false,"large":9007199254740993,"nearOne":1.0000000000000001,"nil":null,"tiny":1e-400} with no trailing newline; numerical tokens, false/null, array order and own __proto__ data preserved; Object prototype is not mutated

cases.given: operation screen omits result_pointer or has source/format mismatch
cases.required_observation: invalid-product-map names exact missing or mismatched field before upload

cases.given: every selected part lacks a map
cases.required_observation: finite no-screen explanation; no nullable map or invented placeholder screen

cases.given: contracts/world.md exists and contains title, prose and a Notes/Readers table but no real Key/Writer header table
cases.required_observation: invalid-product names contracts/world.md and the missing Key/Writer declaration table before upload; do not interpret present malformed declaration source as empty writers
